canonical_project: Dushanbe State Unitary Enterprise Smart City Data Center
notes: Municipal government data processing center (TsOD) inside the new SUE Smart City HQ building commissioned 2025-06-21, opened by President E. Rahmon; press reports >120 server racks and a 24/7 monitoring center. Uptime Institute lists the client with Tier III Certification of Design Documents (design certification, not built certification; per kursiv.media snippet). Certification fact = A (Uptime), commissioning = B (secondary press quoting President press service). Municipal facility, not a commercial colocation offering.
